{"reason": "34 alt-supplier switches at 45000 dominate cost; failure rows show transfers of 2-4 days beat covers of 6+ days, so the medium/high branch action becomes propose-internal-rebalance (6000). Low-cover rows (medium, 2.8 and 5.3 days) stock out, so the alert-planner branch is extended to medium risk below 6 days cover.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 6))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'propose-internal-rebalance))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
